fields.label: Default Company

fields.options: Under Act 1151 (from 1 January 2026) VAT, NHIL and GETFund are charged on the same taxable value, giving 20% combined, and NHIL and GETFund are recoverable as input tax. The 1% COVID-19 Health Recovery Levy was repealed. Every row should therefore be On Net Total — compounding reproduces the cascade the reform removed. Verify against the current GRA schedule before relying on these.

fields.label: Apply Withholding on Purchase Invoices
fields.description: Uses ERPNext's native Tax Withholding Category engine. Assign a category to each supplier.

fields.options: Two-level approval runs on ERPNext's native Expense Claim and Employee Advance, so the employee portal, employee ledger and payment entries keep working.

Off by default on purpose. Payroll Entry creates and submits its accrual journal entry programmatically. An active workflow on Journal Entry governs document status through approval transitions and can leave that journal stranded in Draft, which stops payroll posting. Enable it, then immediately run a test payroll entry before relying on it.
